product.name: Precisio CNC 5-Axis Machining Centre Controller
product.description: Industrial 5-axis CNC machining centre controller with integrated PC-based HMI, real-time motion controller (RTMC), and networked production management interface. Supports STEP-NC and G-code programming. Connects to factory MES/ERP via OPC-UA and MQTT. Remote diagnostics capability via encrypted VPN tunnel. Used in automotive, aerospace, and medical device manufacturing.
product.intended_use: Precision numerical control of 5-axis machining centres in industrial manufacturing environments. Intended for operation by trained CNC operators in CE-marked machining centres. Network connectivity used exclusively for production management data exchange within factory LAN. Remote access only via operator-approved VPN.
product.product_type: Industrial control system — CNC machine controller

releases.release_notes: Initial market release of Precisio CNC 5-Axis Controller. Full feature set: 5-axis interpolation, STEP-NC ISO 14649, G-code, OPC-UA server, MQTT telemetry, VPN remote access, integrated HMI with 21.5" touchscreen. Supports RS-232, Ethernet (1GbE), USB 3.0 for programming and tool management.

vulnerability_reports.title: OPC-UA Server: Unauthenticated NodeId Enumeration via Browse Service
vulnerability_reports.description: The OPC-UA server implementation allows unauthenticated clients to enumerate all server NodeIds via the Browse service without any session establishment. This exposes the full machine data model including production parameters, tool offsets, and operational state to any client with network access to port 4840. OPC Foundation Security Bulletin OPC-2024-006.

vulnerability_reports.title: G-code Parser: Path Traversal in File Upload Handler
vulnerability_reports.description: The G-code program upload handler on the HMI web interface does not sanitise file path components in the Content-Disposition header. A crafted HTTP multipart upload can write arbitrary files to the controller filesystem, including overwriting system configuration files or dropping executable payloads in the autostart directory.

vulnerability_reports.title: VPN Module: OpenVPN 2.5.x — TLS-Auth Key Reuse Vulnerability
vulnerability_reports.description: The bundled OpenVPN 2.5.8 client uses a static TLS-Auth HMAC key shared across all controller units produced before firmware update 1.2.0. Compromise of a single unit's key material enables traffic correlation and session authentication bypass for all units using the same key. Affects approximately 2,400 units shipped before the key rotation update.
vulnerability_reports.reporter_name: Internal Penetration Test — Schneider IT Security

security_advisories.title: OPC-UA NodeId Enumeration — Update to Firmware 1.1.0
security_advisories.summary: The Precisio CNC OPC-UA server permitted unauthenticated node enumeration, exposing machine data models to unauthorised network observers. Firmware 1.1.0 enforces session authentication before Browse operations and enables anonymous access restrictions by default.
security_advisories.workaround: Until firmware update is applied: restrict OPC-UA port 4840 at the factory firewall to authorised MES/SCADA IP addresses only. Enable OPC-UA user authentication in controller network settings.
security_advisories.remediation_steps: 1. Download firmware 1.1.0 from Precisio Customer Portal. 2. Verify SHA-256 hash against published manifest. 3. Apply via HMI Settings > Firmware Update during planned maintenance stop. 4. Reconfigure OPC-UA client certificates after update (see KB-2025-0019).

security_updates.title: Firmware 1.1.0 — OPC-UA Security Hardening
security_updates.description: Enforces authentication for all OPC-UA Browse operations. Anonymous access is disabled by default; existing installations require configuration of X.509 client certificates or username/password credentials. Also includes open62541 library update from 1.3.5 to 1.3.9 addressing two additional low-severity OPC-UA stack issues. Updates OpenSSL from 3.0.7 to 3.0.14.
security_updates.integrity_info: SHA-256: 5e884898da28047151d0e56f8dc6292773603d0d6aabbdd62a11ef721d1542d8. Signed by Precisio Code Signing Root CA. Certificate SHA-1: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

security_updates.title: Firmware 1.1.2 — OpenSSL Critical Update (CVE-2024-5535)
security_updates.description: Emergency patch addressing CVE-2024-5535 (OpenSSL SSL_select_next_proto buffer overread) which affects the MQTT TLS client and VPN module. Upgrades OpenSSL from 3.0.14 to 3.0.15. No functional changes.
security_updates.integrity_info: SHA-256: 7c4a8d09ca3762af61e59520943dc26494f8941b. RailSecure Code Signing Root CA.

risk_assessments.title: Precisio CNC 5X v1.0 — CRA Cybersecurity Risk Assessment
risk_assessments.methodology: STRIDE threat modelling per Microsoft Threat Modeling methodology applied to all external interfaces. Attack surface enumeration per IEC 62443-3-2. Consequence analysis per ISO 12100 machinery safety risk assessment methodology (combined cybersecurity + safety risk view). CVSS 3.1 scoring for all identified threats.
risk_assessments.summary: Five external attack surfaces identified: OPC-UA server, MQTT broker, VPN remote access, HMI web interface, and USB programming interface. Most critical risks relate to network-connected interfaces enabling remote code execution or process parameter manipulation. All critical risks mitigated to acceptable residual level prior to market release. One high-severity risk (HMI path traversal) identified post-release during active vulnerability programme — remediation in progress.

risk_items.title: OPC-UA Unauthenticated Data Exposure
risk_items.description: OPC-UA server exposes machine production data, tool offsets, and operational parameters to any unauthenticated client with network access, enabling industrial espionage or reconnaissance for further attacks.
risk_items.threat_scenario: A competitor or attacker gains access to the factory network (insider, compromised workstation, or MES compromise) and queries the OPC-UA server without credentials to extract sensitive production programme parameters or machine calibration data.
risk_items.asset_affected: OPC-UA server, production programme data, machine configuration parameters
risk_items.mitigation_plan: 1. Enforce OPC-UA session authentication (certificate or username/password) — implemented in firmware 1.1.0. 2. Segment OPC-UA traffic to dedicated VLAN. 3. Log all OPC-UA connections and alert on unauthenticated access attempts. 4. Default configuration ships with authentication required.

risk_items.title: HMI Web Interface — Malicious G-code Upload / Path Traversal
risk_items.description: Exploitation of file upload handling in the HMI web interface could allow an attacker to write arbitrary files to the controller, including overwriting firmware components or injecting malicious autostart scripts.
risk_items.threat_scenario: A disgruntled employee or external attacker with HMI network access crafts a malicious multipart HTTP request exploiting path traversal in the file upload handler. Uploaded payload modifies CNC motion control parameters causing machine damage or operator injury.
risk_items.asset_affected: HMI web server, controller filesystem, motion control software, machine and operator safety
risk_items.mitigation_plan: 1. Rewrite file upload handler with strict path sanitisation (in progress for v1.2.0). 2. Implement allowlist of uploadable file extensions (.nc, .ngc, .tap only). 3. Run G-code validator/sandbox before accepting files. 4. Restrict HMI web access to authenticated operators only. 5. Implement chroot jail for upload handler process.

risk_items.title: VPN Remote Access — Brute Force Authentication
risk_items.description: The OpenVPN remote access gateway does not enforce rate limiting on failed authentication attempts, allowing brute force or credential stuffing attacks against the VPN endpoint.
risk_items.threat_scenario: External attacker identifies the VPN endpoint from network scanning and performs automated credential stuffing using leaked industrial credentials databases, eventually gaining authenticated VPN access and control of the machine.
risk_items.asset_affected: VPN remote access module, remote support interface
risk_items.mitigation_plan: 1. Implement account lockout after 5 failed attempts with 15-minute lockout period. 2. Require certificate + password dual-factor authentication for VPN. 3. Restrict VPN access to Precisio support staff IP ranges by default. 4. Log all VPN connection attempts and alert on anomalous patterns. 5. Implement per-machine VPN keys (addressed in v1.2.0 key rotation).

risk_items.title: USB Programming Interface — Malicious Firmware or G-code via Removable Media
risk_items.description: The USB interface accepts G-code programs and firmware updates from USB drives without digital signature verification, allowing an insider or contractor with physical machine access to load unauthorised code.
risk_items.threat_scenario: A disgruntled maintenance contractor inserts a USB drive containing a modified firmware image or malicious G-code programme that introduces a dangerous motion sequence. Physical access to the machine is required.
risk_items.asset_affected: USB interface, firmware update mechanism, G-code programme storage
risk_items.mitigation_plan: 1. Enforce digital signature verification for all firmware updates (implemented). 2. Add G-code programme signing (optional feature, enables in secure manufacturing environments). 3. USB port can be physically disabled via hardware jumper for high-security installations. 4. Implement USB device allowlist (only Precisio-branded programming drives). 5. Audit log all USB connections.

risk_items.title: Supply Chain Risk — Third-Party Library Vulnerabilities in Real-Time Stack
risk_items.description: The controller relies on open-source components (Linux RT kernel, RTAI, OpenSSL, open62541) that may have undiscovered vulnerabilities. Absence of continuous SBOM vulnerability monitoring could leave known vulnerabilities undetected between scheduled release cycles.
risk_items.threat_scenario: A critical vulnerability is disclosed in a core library (e.g., OpenSSL, Linux kernel networking). Without continuous monitoring, Precisio may not discover the vulnerability until the next scheduled security review cycle, leaving units exposed for months.
risk_items.asset_affected: All network-connected components depending on third-party libraries
risk_items.mitigation_plan: 1. Implement automated SBOM vulnerability scanning using OSV.dev API (weekly scans). 2. Subscribe to security mailing lists for all third-party components. 3. Establish emergency patch process (< 30 days for critical CVEs). 4. Publish SBOM to customers to enable their own vulnerability monitoring. 5. Annual SBOM refresh at minimum.

risk_assessments.title: Precisio CNC 5X v2.0 — AI Cloud Module Supplementary Risk Assessment
risk_assessments.methodology: STRIDE threat modelling for new cloud integration components. Data flow diagram analysis for AI optimisation module communication. Cloud security assessment per CSA CCM v4.0. Remote processing element classification per CRA Article 6 guidance.
risk_assessments.summary: DRAFT — Preliminary assessment of new attack surfaces introduced by AI-assisted cloud toolpath optimisation. Primary concerns: data exfiltration of proprietary production programmes via cloud channel, dependency on cloud availability for optimisation features, and supply chain risks of cloud-side model updates. Three new risk items identified — all currently OPEN pending mitigation design.

risk_items.title: Cloud AI Module — Proprietary G-code Exfiltration via Optimisation Channel
risk_items.description: G-code programmes sent to the Precisio Cloud Optimiser for AI-assisted toolpath analysis contain proprietary manufacturing intellectual property. Compromise of the cloud service or an on-path interception could expose trade secrets.
risk_items.threat_scenario: Advanced attacker compromises Precisio's cloud infrastructure or deploys a TLS interception proxy in the factory DMZ. Production programmes containing aerospace-grade machining sequences are exfiltrated.
risk_items.asset_affected: G-code programme data, customer intellectual property, cloud optimisation channel
risk_items.mitigation_plan: 1. Encrypt programme data at rest in cloud using customer-managed keys (BYOK). 2. Send only toolpath metadata (not programme source) to cloud when possible. 3. Implement E2E encryption from controller to cloud AI endpoint. 4. Provide on-premise optimisation option for sensitive programmes. 5. DPA agreements with all cloud subprocessors.

cvd_policies.policy_text: Precisio Steuerungstechnik AG is committed to responsible vulnerability disclosure for all network-connected products. We request a 90-day coordinated disclosure window from initial report to allow time for patch development, validation against the real-time control stack, and customer notification through our service network. For vulnerabilities with potential for physical harm (e.g., affecting machine motion control), we may request extended coordination with ENISA and relevant national authorities under CRA Article 14. We acknowledge all valid reports within 3 business days and provide regular status updates every 14 days. Researchers who responsibly disclose vulnerabilities to us are eligible for recognition in our Hall of Fame and, for critical vulnerabilities, a bounty under our partner programme. PGP public key available at https://precisio.ch/security/pgp.

support_periods.justification_text: 5-year standard support period for industrial CNC controller. Aligned with typical machine tool service lifecycle and customer investment protection expectations. Extended support (10 years) available via maintenance contract for customers requiring longer assurance horizon.
support_periods.expected_use_time_text: CNC machining centres have operational lifespans of 15-25 years. The controller software is designed for replacement at mid-life overhaul (typically 8-12 years) when hardware platform refresh occurs. 5-year security support covers the initial deployment and early operational phase.
support_periods.comparable_products_text: Fanuc 30i-B series: 5-year standard security update support. Siemens Sinumerik 840D sl: 7-year support. Heidenhain TNC 640: 5-year standard. Precisio aligns with industry standard.
support_periods.third_party_support_constraints_text: Support timeline influenced by Qt 5.15 LTS end of life (November 2025) — upgrade to Qt 6 included in v2.0.0. OpenVPN 2.5.x upstream support ends December 2024 — migration to WireGuard planned for v2.0.0.
support_periods.user_facing_summary: Precisio provides security updates for CNC 5X v1.0.0 firmware until 1 July 2029. Updates are delivered free of charge via Precisio Customer Portal or over-the-air update. Extended support until 2034 available via PSA-PLUS maintenance agreement.
support_periods.packaging_summary: Security updates until: 1 July 2029. Free of charge. Extended support available.

certification_records.scope_description: IEC 62443-4-2 SL2 assessment of Precisio CNC 5X v1.0.0 controller. Scope covers all network interfaces (OPC-UA, MQTT, VPN), software update mechanism, HMI access control, and audit logging. Assessment conducted against 35 foundational requirements.
certification_records.notes: Assessment completed with 2 minor non-conformances remediated via corrective action plan prior to certificate issue. Certificate maintenance review scheduled annually. Patch assessment for v1.1.x updates confirmed no scope changes per TÜV maintenance procedure.

certification_records.scope_description: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification of Precisio Steuerungstechnik AG Information Security Management System covering product development, vulnerability management, customer support, and firmware distribution processes for all CNC product lines.
certification_records.notes: Surveillance audit completed March 2025 with no major non-conformances. Recertification audit scheduled Q4 2026.
